meta.scope_note: Pre-registro del PoC Cleveland Clinic (allosteria molecular): compromiso sellado ANTES de que existan los runs de Fase 2. Hace imposible el cherry-picking de proteinas/parametros.

prereg.title: Pre-Registration — Rosetta Quantum · Cleveland Clinic Allostery PoC
prereg.purpose: Forward commitment sealed BEFORE the Phase-2 molecular PoC runs exist, so proteins and parameters cannot be cherry-picked. Anchored on Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps and mirrored publicly (GitHub + Codeberg + database).
prereg.protocol: Judge v1 — same residue-contact network, same active-site source, same time window both sides; documented allosteric site as referee (defined by neither propagator; read geometrically from the co-crystallised effector where available); frozen library versions.

families: plus >=3 additional families with experimentally-anchored allosteric sites to be drawn, blind, from the Allosteric Database (ASD) + PDB structures co-crystallising their allosteric effector
proteins_committed.ground_truth_rule: allosteric site = residues within 4.5 A of the co-crystallised allosteric effector where present; otherwise documented residues from primary literature, verified by residue-type match against the structure
proteins_committed.network_rule: nodes = Ca atoms; edges = contacts under cutoff; source = active/orthosteric site (catalytic dyad by sequence motif + geometry, or O2/substrate contacts)

parameters_committed.quantum: continuous-time quantum walk, U(t)=exp(-iAt), integrated over the window
parameters_committed.classical: continuous-time diffusion, p(t)=exp(-Lt), integrated over the window
parameters_committed.metric: mean percentile rank of the true allosteric residues among distal residues (>6 A from source); 100 = top

success_criteria.quantum_win: CTQW ranks the documented allosteric site strictly higher than classical diffusion, reproducible across >=2 cutoffs and >=2 protein families (robust to graph construction) — not a single lucky configuration
success_criteria.discrimination_forecast: error-barred estimate of the structural regime (network size, source-to-pocket path length, coupling topology) where CTQW would separate from diffusion
success_criteria.negative_is_valid: a reproducible not-yet is a valid, publishable outcome

prereg.integrity: Every run sha256-sealed, triple-copied, OpenTimestamps-anchored. Any deviation from this pre-registration is disclosed in the run archive.

storage.policy: triple-copia + ancla OTS; el timestamp PRE-DATA los resultados
